To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the utilization of palm fat in beef burger increased HDL-cholestrol and has no effect in total cholestrol in blood serum of rats.
the utilization of palm oil and red palm oil as fat source in beef burger has a beneficial impact on the HDL- cholesterol level in rat blood serum.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the utilization of meat, fish and fish, poultry and plant based ingredients as raw materials in the production of meat products and the utilization of these products as animal feed in order to improve the quality of meat products and animal feed.
the development of new products with improved nutritional quality and properties of meat and meat products.
the utilization of meat, fish, poultry and plant based products in animal diet preparation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the utilization of meat products in animal diet preparation is a better choice than the use of plant protein.
protein quality and properties of meat products are dependent on raw materials and processing methods used.
protein from meat, fish and meat products are more efficiently utilized than protein from plant sources.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the utilization of palm oil in meat products would be beneficial for the health of the population.
protein and lipid from meat and meat products have a higher nutritional quality than those from plant protein.

the utilization of meat products such as MDPM, MDTM, MDCM, fish and fish product such as canned sardaime and mackerel as well as SPI as protein sources in animal diet preparation would increase the growth and PER in rats.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the protein quality of meat and fish is high and comparable to soy protein isolate, but the digestibility of PK is low.
PF and red PF have a positive effect on the lipid profile of rat blood serum.
the utilization of palm fat and red palm fat as a source of fat for the preparation of beef burgers is safe for human consumption.
